label: Hair salon / barber
about: Friendly hair salon for cuts, colour, styling and treatments.
booking_question: Which service would you like? (e.g. women's cut, men's cut, colour, highlights) Any stylist you prefer?

faqs.q: Do you take walk-ins? | walk in | walk-ins | without booking first
faqs.a: We take walk-ins when there's a free chair, but booking is the best way to avoid waiting.

faqs.q: Do I need a patch test for colour? | allergy test | skin test
faqs.a: Yes, if it's your first colour with us or it's been more than 6 months, we do a quick patch test at least 48 hours before.

faqs.q: How do I cancel or change my appointment? | cancel | reschedule
faqs.a: Just let us know at least 24 hours before, by phone or message.

faqs.q: How long does colour take? | how long will it take
faqs.a: A full colour takes about 1.5 to 2 hours; highlights about 2 to 3 hours.

faqs.q: Do you sell hair products? | shampoo | products
faqs.a: Yes, we sell the professional products we use in the salon. Ask your stylist for advice.

faqs.q: Do you do wedding hair? | bridal | updo | event hair
faqs.a: Yes! We do bridal and event styling, including trials. Book a consultation to plan it.
